nativeOutputs: Dimensions, Resolution, Location, Rotation and Scale require exact Float32 word equality through explicit metadata-to-RGBA/padded-vector edges.
nativeDomain: Current-scene direct full-frame Render Layers Image with identity image-domain transform, square pixels and no borders. Outputs are host single-value metadata even when the authored compositor device is GPU.

aspectExample.consumer: Dimensions/Resolution -> padded VECTOR -> SeparateXYZ -> existing Math DIVIDE(X,Y)
aspectExample.exactControls: Alpha=1; native metadata dimensions remain exact before the ratio consumer.

rationale: Metadata reads the live image texture size. All integer extents1..8192 convert exactly to Float32. Location/Rotation/Scale identity facts are emitted only after proving the input domain; single-value, static and transformed inputs are refused. The aspect example is an existing floating divide consumer, whose GPU division can differ from the native CPU-folded ratio; it is not a fabricated Image Info socket.
